# One Take Wonder Marketing

> One Take Wonder Marketing is a full-service marketing and media-buying agency in Orlando, Florida, serving local businesses across the United States. It plans, buys and measures advertising across TV and streaming (CTV/OTT), radio and streaming audio, paid search, paid social, SEO, web design, video production and brand creative. It was founded by Palloma Earl and has over 10 years of experience.

The agency works as one team across strategy, media and creative, so a client gets a single plan, a single point of contact and one set of numbers rather than separate vendors per channel. Engagements are built around the client's budget and measured on return, not impressions.

## Services

- Media Buying: strategic ad placement and negotiation across TV, streaming, radio, digital and print.
- TV & Streaming Advertising: connected TV (CTV) and OTT campaigns, targeted by geography and audience.
- Radio & Streaming Audio: broadcast radio and streaming audio placement.
- PPC & Paid Search: high-intent search campaigns on Google and Bing.
- Social Media Advertising: paid social across Meta, TikTok and other platforms.
- SEO & SEM: search engine optimization and search marketing.
- Web Design & Development: conversion-focused website design and build.
- Video Production: commercial, social and brand video.
- Creative & Content: brand creative, campaign concepts and content production.
- Brand Strategy: positioning, messaging and go-to-market planning.
- Market Research & Consumer Insights: audience and competitive research before media spend.
- Conversion Rate Optimization: improving the conversion rate of existing traffic.
